business_problem: WeLab Bank needed to improve digital onboarding by increasing ID-verification accuracy across devices, reducing manual approvals, maintaining Hong Kong compliance, and giving distributed developers better cross-border access to engineering systems.
solution_summary: WeLab Bank combined several Alibaba Cloud services to improve onboarding and operational collaboration for its digital bank. ZOLOZ Real ID supplies the AI-driven eKYC layer that validates identity documents and extracts onboarding data more accurately while supporting regulatory compliance. Around that workflow, Wuying Workspace (Elastic Desktop Service) and Cloud Enterprise Network connect the bank's Hong Kong headquarters with its Guangzhou development center so remote teams can work with stronger performance and more controlled access. The broader architecture is governed through Alibaba Cloud's cloud-based IT design approach, which the customer story frames around Landing Zone-style planning and security controls. This means the solution is not limited to front-end verification: it also improves how distributed teams deliver cross-border financial products while the bank explores future user-behavior analytics for sales and marketing. Together these services give WeLab Bank a faster onboarding experience, a more manageable operating model, and better support for compliant digital-banking growth.
business_outcome: WeLab Bank streamlined customer onboarding, improved compliance and cross-border collaboration, and created a stronger base for digital-banking growth.
architecture_clues: Supports both onboarding and remote developer collaboration
Cross-border connectivity links Hong Kong and Guangzhou teams
The solution includes explicit regulatory documentation for AI methodologies
Future work includes big-data analysis of user behavior for marketing
